lastCompletedStory.title: Make promoteSuggestionOnMain a single atomic on-main commit

nextStoryContext: promoteSuggestionOnMain (src/commands/suggestions.ts) now bypasses createLocalIssueOnMain entirely and calls writeIssueFile (US-001, CAM-290) directly, passing the rewritten pen content as extraFiles and a commitMessage override; the filed issue JSON and the pen-line removal now land in ONE atomic on-main commit. PromoteSuggestionOnMainSuccess collapsed issueSha/penSha into a single sha field (index.ts's promote printer and every test fake constructing that literal were updated to match). dismissSuggestionOnMain and buildPromotedDescription are unchanged. See the patterns.md bullet 'Collapsing a two-writer on-main sequence into one atomic commit...' (US-002, CAM-290) for the exact refactor shape.
